newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble o/n rates firm, trade calm on US holiday.
newsitem.headline: Rouble o/n rates firm, trade calm on US holiday.

text.p: The rouble was little changed on Monday due to a U.S. holiday but dealers said rouble overnight credit rates firmed as banks sought funds to maintain liquidity in thinner trading.
roubles/dollar May 26 midday May 26 early May 23 close
"Banks have to maintain liquidity on the credit market as the rouble/dollar is relatively illiquid because of the U.S. holiday," a Rossiisky Kredit Bank dealer said.
Another dealer said rouble credit rates were higher on demand from a major bank which is a major T-bill market-maker.
"A market-maker came and was buying overnight roubles quite high and in big volumes," he said.
